text:
Sam (Support): FYI customer reported that after the request-mapper v3 rollout their external action hooks (billing-hook) stop firing. They say the assistant returns text only, no action call. Can we triage?

Jess (SRE): Which customer / request id? Any repro?

Sam (Support): Acme reported. Request ID: req_0a1b2c3d. Happened at 2025-03-14T15:20:10Z (approx). They included a minimal repro curl.

Sam (Support): curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-1","input":"Charge customer for order #12345","enable_plugins":true,"plugins":["billing-hook"]}'

Maya (ML Eng): Can you paste the model response (raw JSON) from Acme? Need to see if `tool_call` field is missing or empty.

Sam (Support): They pasted this response body: 

{
  "id": "res_aa11",
  "object": "generation",
  "output": { "type": "assistant_message", "content": "Charge processed. Receipt sent." },
  "tool_calls": []
}

Ravi (Backend): Hmm empty tool_calls. Prior to mapper v3 we saw non-empty tool_calls for the same prompt. Do we have deploy-bot notes?

deploy-bot: Deployed request-mapper v3 to regions: us-west1/us-east1 at 2025-03-14T14:50:03Z. Canary 30% -> 100% completed at 2025-03-14T15:10:00Z. Commit: 7d9f3e2.

Jess (SRE): Got it. Canary finished ~10m before customer hit. Sam, can you ask Acme for the full request headers (especially X-Request-Map-Version / Accept / Content-Type) and the route tag? Also confirm whether they were hitting a dedicated or hosted endpoint.

Sam (Support): Asked, they sent headers: Authorization, Content-Type: application/json, User-Agent: acme-billing/1.2. They are on hosted. No special X- headers.

Maya (ML Eng): Hypothesis: v3 introduced a request normalization that strips plugin metadata or rewrites the streaming hook path. Could also be a side-effect of the new `compact_response` flag we added to reduce payload size — maybe it collapses the tool_calls array when only one call is present.

Ravi (Backend): I'll grep logs for req_0a1b2c3d in request-mapper traces. If the mapper removed attach_tool=true, the runtime will not emit tool call events.

Ravi (Backend): Found trace (map_trace_991): incoming payload had plugins: ["billing-hook"], request-mapper v3 applied a transform: removed field `plugins` when `compact_response:true`. That looks like a bug.

Maya (ML Eng): Oof. That matches. The transform was added to remove client plugin hints to reduce token size; but we intended to keep them for downstream runtime routing. Missing field means runtime sees no enabled plugins -> no tool_calls.

Jess (SRE): Workaround: set header `X-Enable-Legacy-Plugin-Hints: true` or pin request-mapper to v2 for affected customers. Can we hotfix v3 to not drop `plugins`?

Ravi (Backend): I pushed a patch to keep `plugins` in transform if `enable_plugins` is true. Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood/request-mapper/pull/482. Can we do a quick canary?

deploy-bot: Rollout request-mapper v3.0.1 canary started at 2025-03-14T16:05:12Z (10% -> will hold)

Sam (Support): Told Acme temporary mitigation: include `X-Enable-Legacy-Plugin-Hints: true` header or wait for patch. They replied it's actionable; appreciate the update.

Maya (ML Eng): After canary verification, we'll schedule full rollout. Also adding an integration test to make sure `tool_calls` survive transformations.

Jess (SRE): Action items: Ravi to confirm patch fixes trace for sample reqs; Maya to add test; Sam to follow up with customer when canary completes.

Ravi (Backend): Confirmed on canary host: req_123_test shows tool_calls preserved and billing-hook invoked. Logs: `tool_dispatch: billing-hook, id=hook_77a`

Sam (Support): Noted. I'll update the ticket and mark P1-> mitigated.

Maya (ML Eng): Long term: add pre-flight assert in mapper CI that `plugins` is not dropped when `enable_plugins` is true (and when user explicitly lists plugins).

Jess (SRE): Thanks team. Sam — please post customer closure note here once Acme confirms calls restored.

Sam (Support): Will do. :thumbsup:
